svg.text: Measured inputs: photon detection fraction eps(v) and dark rate b(v), 2026-11-10
A. eps(v) = (light - dark) / same at the valley
B. dark rate: raw thresholds and the smoothed b(v)
eps(v) from room-light scans (light 13:59, light 17:24); b(v) from the 2026-11-10 dark scans (dark 13:20, dark 16:36). R8486 at ~1000 V (operator; HV not in the files).
A: eps is plotted with the 13:20 dark subtracted; with the 16:36 dark it differs by at most 0.004% at any headline candidate level (valley and above). Poisson error on eps is
~0.5 % per level, smaller than the markers. B: error bars are Poisson; open triangles are thresholds with zero counts, plotted at the 95 % upper limit 3/T.
Grey, panel A: below the valley eps reaches 1.41: the light-on rate there is more than photons + dark noise, and the excess falls with the level like the electronic noise.
Levels below the valley are therefore left out of the headline answer (sensitivity check only), as the driver also leaves them out. Panel B: on the steep 2.2-3.6 mV roll-off
the fit is within x1.12 of the raw dark rate.
The 16:36 dark scan is coarse above 7.2 mV (7.2, 9.2, 11.2 ... mV), so its b(v) between those points is a fit across a +-2 mV window, not a local measurement. Light-scan
counts are summed over 3 up and 3 down passes at each level.
